d: Short, wavy pastel pink hair is styled with thick bangs and high twin-tails. The large, round, olive-gold eyes convey a blank, innocent expression on a youthful, child-like face. A small, petite build is dressed in a white sleeveless top paired with a dark teal oversized jacket draped over the shoulders, complemented by black boots and a black choker with a gold ring. Signature accessories include a yellow visor with two tall, glowing white neon tubes extending upward, and a small, white fluffy stuffed rabbit held in the arms.
